hero.headline: Fractional Co-ownership
hero.title: “Your holiday home is not a dream. It is a decision you have not made yet”
hero.description: Own an apartment in the most iconic tower in Bocagrande from COP $173M.
hero.videoLabel: Invictvs video on the Bocagrande beachfront

model.headline: What is Arena Property?
model.title: The smart way to own the Caribbean
model.tagline: Structuring fractional co-ownership of second homes, through an S.A.S. company, with professional hotel operation.
model.description: Arena Property structures and manages fractional co-ownership of luxury second homes, to make the investment and the running costs efficient in properties that are used little during the year. We take part as founding co-owners in every project.
model.lead: You buy 1/8 of a premium holiday property, registered in your name in trust, and a single operator takes care of everything else. All sized to how much you use it.

owner.title: You are a real owner
owner.description: Your 1/8 is registered in the project trust. Real ownership of a beachfront asset to enjoy 6 weeks a year. Likewise, expenses are shared in proportion to your fraction.

price.title: From COP $173M
price.description: In instalments and without an additional mortgage. You access the most premium asset in Bocagrande with a fraction of the total capital.

carefree.title: No worries
carefree.description: A single tourism operator handles rentals, guests and monthly reporting. Distributions in proportion to your 1/8.

benefits.headline: What are the benefits of Arena Property?
benefits.title: Eight owners, zero worries
benefits.description: You own your holiday home in the Caribbean for a fraction of the investment and the running costs.
benefits.lead: Compared with buying a whole property, the fraction gives you the best of the Caribbean for a part of the cost and without carrying the operation.

capital.title: A fraction of the capital
capital.description: From COP $173M in 30 instalments, instead of more than COP $1,384M for the whole apartment.

income.title: Income when you are not using it
income.description: Free nights are rented to third parties and the income is shared with your fraction.

ownership.title: Your fraction is yours
ownership.description: Registered in trust and traceable; you can transfer it whenever you decide.

weeks.title: 42 nights a year
weeks.description: Weeks spread across the four seasons, with fair rotation among the eight co-owners.

management.title: Centralised operation
management.description: Scheduling, shared expenses, maintenance and communication live on the platform.

transparency.title: Clear accounts
transparency.description: Monthly reports and every peso with its record. Nothing estimated is presented as confirmed.

properties.headline: Active properties
properties.title: What is on sale today
properties.description: Name, location, area, bedrooms, bathrooms and fraction price: the quick sheet of every published project.
properties.empty: We will publish the next properties soon.

scheduling.headline: How does the scheduling model work?
scheduling.title: 6 weeks a year per fraction
scheduling.description: In luxury co-ownership the promise is expressed in weeks: 1/8 equals six weeks a year. Arena Property keeps that unit so you can compare. Six weeks are exactly 42 nights, spread by season:

whatWeDo.headline: What does Arena Property do?
whatWeDo.title: Three things for every property
whatWeDo.description: And all three are permanent over time, except the first.
whatWeDo.partner: Arena also joins as one more partner, on the same terms as everyone else. Its income is a declared fee for structuring each company and a monthly fee for managing it.

structure.title: We structure
structure.description: We analyse the asset, gather a closed group of nominated partners and incorporate the company (S.A.S.) that buys the property, divided into eight equal fractions.

commercialize.title: We place
commercialize.description: We find and qualify the partners of each property. Placement is private and one to one, never open.

manage.title: We manage
manage.description: We are the property manager for as long as the company exists. Cleaning, maintenance, suppliers, property tax, insurance, utilities and the relationship with the tourism operator go through us, not the partners. That is the work that makes co-ownership run without friction.

cta.title: Reserve your place at Invictvs
cta.description: Bocagrande beachfront, 53 floors and estimated delivery in 2029. Create your account and we walk with you from the first call to your registered fraction.

hero.headline: Business model
hero.title: Fractional co-ownership, explained from start to finish
hero.description: You buy 1/8 of a premium holiday property, registered in your name in trust, and a single operator takes care of everything else. This is how it works and how you become the owner of a fraction.

structure.headline: How it is built
structure.title: One property, eight owners, one operation
structure.description: Every property is structured the same way, and that is what makes co-ownership run without friction.

fractions.title: Eight equal fractions
fractions.description: Each property is divided into exactly eight fractions. You buy one and become a co-owner alongside seven partners, on the same terms.

ownership.title: Real ownership, in trust
ownership.description: An S.A.S. company owns the property and your 1/8 is shares in that company, registered in the project trust: real, traceable and transferable ownership.

seasons.title: Usage rights by season
seasons.description: Each fraction gets six weeks a year spread across the four seasons, with a picking order that rotates every year so the split stays fair.

operation.title: Centralised operation
operation.description: Scheduling, shared expenses, maintenance, suppliers and communication live on the platform. You use it; Arena and the operator do the rest.

whatWeDo.headline: What Arena Property does
whatWeDo.title: Three things for every property
whatWeDo.description: And all three are permanent over time, except the first.
whatWeDo.partner: Arena also joins as one more partner, on the same terms as everyone else. Its income is a declared fee for structuring each company and a monthly fee for managing it.

structure.title: We structure
structure.description: We analyse the asset, gather a closed group of nominated partners and incorporate the company that buys the property, divided into eight equal fractions.

commercialize.title: We place
commercialize.description: We find and qualify the partners of each property. Placement is private and one to one, never open.

manage.title: We manage
manage.description: We are the property manager for as long as the company exists. Cleaning, maintenance, suppliers, property tax, insurance, utilities and the relationship with the tourism operator go through us, not the partners.

fund.title: Not a fund
fund.description: Nor a proprietary capital vehicle: you buy a stake in the company that owns one specific property.

timeshare.title: Not a timeshare
timeshare.description: You are a shareholder of the company that owns the property, with real and transferable ownership.

yield.title: No promise of operating returns
yield.description: The return comes from use and possible appreciation, not from rent. Nothing estimated is presented as confirmed.

whole_weeks.title: Use by whole weeks
whole_weeks.description: Each week runs Saturday to Saturday, check-in at 15:00 and check-out at 11:00. You pick and use whole weeks.

confirmation.title: Confirm up to 60 days ahead

cancellation.title: Cancel up to 30 days ahead

released_rent.title: The week you release is yours if it rents

faq.headline: Frequently asked questions
faq.title: What everyone asks before buying
faq.description: Short, honest answers. If anything is still unclear, write to us.

what_is.question: What exactly is a fraction?
what_is.answer: It is 1/8 of a holiday property. An S.A.S. company owns the property and your fraction is shares in that company, registered in the project trust.

ownership.question: Is the fraction really mine?
ownership.answer: Yes. It is real, traceable and transferable ownership. It is not a timeshare or a right of use: you are a shareholder of the company that owns the property.

weeks.question: How many weeks can I use per year?
weeks.answer: Six whole weeks, which are 42 nights: one in high season, one in mid-high, one in mid and three in low. The picking order rotates every year.

expenses.question: Who pays the property expenses?
expenses.answer: The eight co-owners, in proportion to their fraction: 1/8 each. Arena manages the shared expenses and delivers a monthly report with every peso recorded.

income.question: Do I earn income when I am not using it?
income.answer: The weeks you do not confirm go to the rental pool. The operator rents them to third parties and the income is shared with your fraction. It is variable income, never a promise.

transfer.question: Can I sell or transfer my fraction?
transfer.answer: Yes. The fraction is transferable; Arena records the transfer as an audited operation, deciding with you what happens to the weeks and pending instalments.

operator.question: Who looks after the guests?
operator.answer: A single tourism operator handles rentals, guests and reporting. You do not look after anyone: you simply use your fraction when it is your turn.

arena_role.question: What does Arena Property earn?
arena_role.answer: A declared fee for structuring each company and a monthly fee for managing it. We also join as one more partner, on the same terms as everyone else.
